ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to scan desktop pairing QR codes and take photos for chat messages and drawings.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to access calendars when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to access calendars when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Allow The Boss to add calendar events when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to access reminders when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to access reminders when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: The Boss does not read or track your motion and fitness activity. This permission description is required by the location service included in the app.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to use your location when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to preview and select photos for drawings and chat messages.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to save photos.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to read selected health and fitness data when you ask the assistant.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: The Boss reads selected Apple Health data to answer your health and fitness questions. It does not save or modify data in Apple Health.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow The Boss to connect to The Boss desktop app, AI providers, and MCP servers on your local network.
